result:
The United States Declaration of Independence was formally adopted by the Continental Congress on **July 4, 1776**. 

However, it is a common historical misconception that it was signed by everyone on that day. While the document was approved on July 4, most historians believe the official signing ceremony took place on **August 2, 1776**.
